sources.passage: Goldman Sachs | Associate | Selected ## Coding Round - HackerRank Date : 28th Feb https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/625140/goldman-sachs-oa-2020-array-burst-proble-uho3/ Solved in around 20 minutes ## Round 1 : DSA CoderPad Date : 18th March 1. Convert a string to smaller string (abcabcd -> abc*d) Append * at current index if prefix string repeats itself from current index. (aaaa -> a**) 2. Given a list of student test scores, find the best average grade. (Can find testcase in other articles) **How did I perform?** Struggled in first question. I asked to jump to 2nd question and come back on 1st later since I was not able to think the approach. Solved 2nd question in very less time but couldn't complete the final solution for first problem, some edge cases handling were missing and time was almost over. ## Round 2 : DSA CoderPad Date : 24th March 1. Find first character unique in a string (abbccdd -> a, bbccdda -> a) 2. https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/1531556/coder-pad-round-goldman-sachs-by-anonymo-50cl/ **How did I perform?** Started with bruteforce for first and then went on to optimise for constant space. For second, I started with a recursive exhaustive approach. Coded the solution and then discussed time complexity. Then went ahead to optimise it to O(n*m) time complexity and completed the code. And then later optimised space by modifying input matrix. Finished round in ~45 minutes. ## Superday Date : 26th March ##### Round 1 : Only DSA 1. Randomly shuffle a list of 500 songs https://leetcode.com/problems/shuffle-an-array/description/ 2. Update the solution to have 50 most frequent songs picked with greater probability. **How did I perform?** Started with bruteforce approach of using random() function to generate index and discussed various other approaches. But couldn't arrive to solution they were expecting. Since time was close to end, they gave hint to solve it. 2nd question was easier to follow up once the first question was done. Overall felt, I am done after this round. ##### Round 2 : Design and DSA - Discussed my current role, projects I have been working on. Asked to explain one of my feature and there were many questions raised on design and why it was done so. Also was asked to discuss some components after suggested changes. - Find prefix sum of 1d array - Find prefix sum of 2d array - https://leetcode.com/pr

# Goldman Sachs Interview Experience for Summer Analyst Intern (On-Campus)

Last Updated : 23 Jul, 2025

**Online Test:**

1. Aptitude Section
2. CS Fundamentals Section
3. Essay Writing
4. 2 Coding Questions (Easy to Medium Level)

The test was conducted on Hackerrank and was un-proctored, and there was no section-based timing.

**Round 1:**

1. Introduce yourself.
2. A brief discussion of my Projects
3. **Coding question:**  
   Calculate the number of ways to encode a string(only digits 0-9) in the following way:

```
Input: “121” 
Output: 3 (Possible Encodings: “ABA”, “AU”, “LA”)
```

**Puzzle:** [Minimum number of steps to weigh 1 kg rice with 1gm weight](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/aptitude/puzzle-minimum-number-steps-to-weigh-1-kg-rice-with-1gm-weight/)

**Round 2:**

1. Group the same sum pairs in an array.

   ```
   Input: {0,1,2,3} 
   Output:[[(0,3),(1,2)], 
   [(1,3)], 
   [(0,2)], 
   [(0,1)], 
   [(2,3)] 
   ]
   ```
2. Print the numbers from 1 to 10,000 which have their factor sum equal to themselves. [For example: 6(1+2+3=6)]
3. Why do you want to be a software engineer?
4. What have you done to reach your goal of becoming a software engineer beyond college?
5. Which OS do you use? Why didn’t you try installing Linux!

I was able to do both the coding questions with optimal time complexities but had issues with the last two questions as the interviewer just went on asking me as to why didn’t I install Linux and wasn’t much convinced with my answer that MacOS is also UNIX based and how bash scripting can be easily done on the zsh shell of Mac. I didn’t proceed further
